Only movement, E, and C. No menu/escape.

Let me reconsider the map one more time. The map at radius 20:
```
  6 #......o....#
  7 #.@P....#...#
```
Row 6 has 'o' at x=7 (the Gold Door). Row 7 has '@' at x=2, 'P' at x=3. The board is at (2,7) = my tile.

Wait — maybe the board is NOT at (2,7). The world_find said "Notice Board (notice) at (2,7): blocks [0 tiles]". But maybe the board's actual blocking tile is different and it's just "0 tiles" because it's near me. Let me check the map for an 'o' near (2,7) — there's no 'o' at (2,7) in the map! The map shows '.' at (2,7). So the board is NOT rendered as a blocking 'o' on the map at (2,7).

This means the board might be a non-blocking decorative object, and my inability to move is something else entirely. But the map shows all '.' around me — fully walkable. Yet I can't move.

Hmm, could it be that my body is "asleep" or the input isn't registering movement? The stamina stays 100. Let me try a very long hold (5 seconds) in one direction.
